definition: 15 independent scroll interaction patterns; selection is problem-led, not a design-style preset.

systems.title: Reading Progress Rail
systems.purpose: Show genuine position in a long readable document, not an ornamental percentage.
systems.trigger: Root document scroll relative to scrollable height.
systems.canonicalState: Clamp scrollTop / max(1, scrollHeight - viewportHeight) to 0..1; guard zero-length document.
systems.visibleResult: An optional progress indicator complementary to headings and anchors.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: CSS animation-timeline: scroll(root block) inside @supports; keep indicator purely supplemental.
implementation.advanced: Coalesced passive scroll + resize observer or Motion useScroll for a semantic aria-valuenow when needed.

fallback.noJs: All document sections and headings remain readable without the rail.
fallback.reducedMotion: Remove the moving rail or show a static section index; do not trap reading.
fallback.mobile: Use a subtle or absent rail on small screens; never overlap headers or system navigation.

systems.rejectWhen: Page is short, there is no longform need, or the marker pretends to represent meaningful milestones.

systems.title: Scroll-Synced Chapter Index
systems.purpose: Help readers find sections and know which chapter is currently being read.
systems.trigger: Section visibility crossings plus explicit anchor navigation.
systems.canonicalState: One active section ID selected by a deterministic visibility policy; URL anchors remain authoritative.
systems.visibleResult: A linked table of contents receives aria-current="location" on its active link.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Native sticky navigation and IntersectionObserver (activation), plus scroll-margin-top for anchors.
implementation.advanced: GSAP ScrollTrigger enter/enterBack for complex pinned contexts; same section ID model.

fallback.noJs: The table of contents is a functioning set of fragment links without JS.
fallback.reducedMotion: Disable animated index transitions, retain the exact active link.
fallback.mobile: Recompose to an ordinary compact jump list rather than a persistent overlay.

systems.rejectWhen: Fewer than three meaningful chapters or current-section status has no practical benefit.

systems.title: Native Snap Chapter Strip
systems.purpose: Allow direct browsing of finite media or related chapters without forced page pinning.
systems.trigger: User-driven horizontal swipe, trackpad, keyboard/tab and previous/next controls.
systems.canonicalState: Native scroll position and stable item IDs; no fake carousel index separate from the DOM.
systems.visibleResult: A horizontally scrollable group using proximity snapping and visible neighboring context.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: overflow-x:auto; scroll-snap-type:x proximity; scroll-padding; anchor links or real buttons.
implementation.advanced: Optional JS scrollIntoView and an IntersectionObserver to update a live position label.

fallback.noJs: The overflow container remains natively scrollable and every item stays in DOM.
fallback.reducedMotion: Keep native scroll behavior; disable animated smooth scrolling.
fallback.mobile: Use touch-native swiping with visible next/previous access; avoid horizontal-only text.

systems.rejectWhen: A carousel hides core prose, traps keyboard focus, or mandatory snapping prevents reading a tall card.

systems.title: Sticky Evidence Exchange
systems.purpose: Let one evidence illustration stay visible while sequential verified findings change its interpretation.
systems.trigger: Narrative steps enter a defined viewport band.
systems.canonicalState: Active step ID derived from the currently intersecting section; never manage a parallel scene clock.
systems.visibleResult: Sticky panel updates supporting label or diagram while all evidence steps remain in document order.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: CSS position:sticky and IntersectionObserver; use real captions and figures.
implementation.advanced: Motion useScroll or GSAP ScrollTrigger only if interpolation between steps is necessary.

fallback.noJs: Show evidence and interpretation beside each step without a persistent stage.
fallback.reducedMotion: Replace sticky stage with ordinary figures and captions.
fallback.mobile: At 320/390px place the figure immediately before its relevant step, not over the text.

systems.rejectWhen: Every step uses the same unrelated image or the pinned stage is taller than the viewport.

systems.title: Data-Linked Scrollytelling
systems.purpose: Coordinate observed values, plot cursor, units and explanation from one sourced dataset.
systems.trigger: Scroll stage progress or deliberate step changes (with explicit value navigation).
systems.canonicalState: One clamped progress variable resolves one deterministic row or interpolation, with data provenance.
systems.visibleResult: Text readout and chart marker reflect the same point, never fabricated telemetry.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Use a static SVG chart/table first; optional CSS view timeline for visual emphasis.
implementation.advanced: GSAP scrub or Motion useScroll -> useTransform; retain exact textual value navigation.

fallback.noJs: A labelled table and descriptive chart expose all relevant values.
fallback.reducedMotion: Show chart plus static annotated values in reading order.
fallback.mobile: Unpin data graphics for cramped screens; data table remains directly reachable.

systems.rejectWhen: Sources lack real numeric data or the interpolation suggests unobserved precision.

systems.title: SVG Journey Trace
systems.purpose: Visually connect a documented sequence with a line that advances along actual milestones.
systems.canonicalState: Path progress from measured length and validated stage positions, mapped to chronology IDs.
systems.visibleResult: stroke-dashoffset draws connecting path; real list titles remain always visible.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: SVG vector-effect where appropriate; CSS scroll timeline where supported; path visible as baseline.
implementation.advanced: Motion useScroll + pathLength / GSAP; compute real SVG length, no hardcoded decorative route units.

fallback.noJs: A complete ordered chronology with explicit dates and content.
fallback.reducedMotion: Render a static visible connector or a plain timeline list.
fallback.mobile: Replace complex curves with short vertical connector or no connector.

systems.rejectWhen: The route implies precise geography or time without supporting source data.
risks: route looks like factual GIS data

systems.title: Horizontal Editorial Gallery
systems.purpose: Present a genuine sequence of visual work as an editorial spread with spatial continuity.
systems.trigger: Vertical section scroll mapped to horizontal track travel, only when explicitly justified.
systems.canonicalState: Travel distance max(0, scrollWidth - clientWidth), recomputed for resize/images/font load.
systems.visibleResult: Track traverses framed work while every panel has anchors, headings and accessible links.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Prefer a native horizontal overflow gallery before considering pinned vertical-to-horizontal mapping.
implementation.advanced: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin/scrub with matchMedia cleanup, focus navigation and anchor correction.

fallback.noJs: All panels remain accessible in normal vertical DOM flow or via native overflow.
fallback.reducedMotion: No pinning; stack editorial panels vertically.
fallback.mobile: Use swipe-native or vertically stacked panels; never translate offscreen focused text.

systems.rejectWhen: Long reading copy, essential controls offscreen, or panels could not be reached by keyboard.

systems.title: Layered Card Stack
systems.purpose: Convey accumulating chapters or a physical stack of related authentic artifacts.
systems.trigger: Each card enters sticky viewport position then yields to the next.
systems.canonicalState: DOM order is canonical; CSS sticky top offsets establish the visual pile only.
systems.visibleResult: Cards overlap gradually while headings and focusable elements remain accessible.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: CSS position:sticky with finite container and short section geometry, avoid forced heights.
implementation.advanced: Optional GSAP scale/translate for restrained depth; no opacity fade that hides content.

fallback.noJs: Plain sequential card list with identical content and intact headings.
fallback.mobile: Unstack into full-width articles with comfortable spacing.

systems.rejectWhen: Interactive controls are covered by later cards or stories have no accumulating relationship.

systems.title: Depth Parallax Theatre
systems.purpose: Show spatial relationships in multi-layer illustration or authentic architectural imagery.
systems.trigger: Scene-local scroll progress, not pointer position.
systems.canonicalState: Single progress value transformed to bounded depth offsets per decor layer.
systems.visibleResult: Foreground and distant layers travel at restrained relative speeds; copy stays fixed in reading order.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: CSS view timeline for transform-only optional decor with baseline layered composition.
implementation.advanced: Motion useScroll/useTransform or GSAP for geometry-linked depth; throttle Canvas loops.

fallback.noJs: A composed static layered image/illustration with full description.
fallback.reducedMotion: Zero transform, no animated zoom; show static composition.
fallback.mobile: Limit travel; protect readability and prefer single-layer composition on narrow screens.

systems.rejectWhen: Motion competes with text, layers have no narrative/spatial purpose, or visual occludes controls.

systems.title: Aperture & Mask Reveal
systems.purpose: Control what part of a verified image is revealed to support a real discovery.
systems.canonicalState: Clip inset/radius/shape interpolated from progress with clear 0 and 1 endpoints.
systems.visibleResult: More of an authentic image becomes visible while caption and subject remain legible.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Use CSS clip-path and @supports(animation-timeline: view()); baseline shows full image.
implementation.advanced: Motion useTransform to clip-path or GSAP timeline; no hidden media dependency.

fallback.noJs: Full authentic photograph with meaningful caption and readable context.
fallback.reducedMotion: Show entire still immediately (not a frozen aperture).
fallback.mobile: Use contextual image crop and no forced reveal.

systems.rejectWhen: Reveal conceals essential details or the image has no factual narrative role.

systems.title: Before–After Split Reveal
systems.purpose: Compare two documented states of the same artifact with identical framing.
systems.trigger: Scroll progress or user-controlled native range slider.
systems.canonicalState: Reveal fraction clamped 0..1, with labelled before/after captions sharing one model.
systems.visibleResult: A split view lets readers inspect change without losing context.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Two images same size/alignment, CSS clip-path, native range input as direct control.
implementation.advanced: Motion scroll mapping only when it does not replace direct keyboard/touch comparison.

fallback.noJs: Two full, correctly labelled images displayed consecutively.
fallback.reducedMotion: Side-by-side or stacked before/after stills; interactive range remains operable if offered.
fallback.mobile: Stack images and prefer a draggable native slider with enough target size.

systems.rejectWhen: Before/after images are unrelated or the interactive view hides material evidence.

systems.title: Object Sequence Scrub
systems.purpose: Reveal actual steps of making through ordered frames or reproducible object states.
systems.trigger: Section progress mapped to discrete frame indices.
systems.canonicalState: frameIndex=floor(clamp01(progress)*(frameCount-1)); index reused for caption and object.
systems.visibleResult: Sourced visual stages show real change, optionally supplemented by model rotation.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Use still frames or sprite/CSS step animation with an accessible stage index.
implementation.advanced: Canvas image-sequence/GSAP with preloading window, frame caching, DPR cap and cleanup.

fallback.noJs: Contact sheet of labelled stages or representative source frames.
fallback.reducedMotion: Provide immediately readable beginning/middle/end annotated images.
fallback.mobile: Use 2–4 representative stills, without a pinned multi-screen preload stage.

systems.rejectWhen: Frames are generated without evidence or media budget blocks reading/performance.

systems.title: Typographic Disclosure
systems.purpose: Reveal a documented statement progressively to match a valid editorial argument.
systems.canonicalState: Progress maps to visual emphasis only; semantic text content is always complete.
systems.visibleResult: Words shift emphasis or underline rather than becoming undiscoverable text.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: CSS background-size/color/opacity on decor and native readable text; limit effect to a short quote.
implementation.advanced: Motion useScroll with stable pre-rendered text spans; no per-character layout shifts.

fallback.noJs: Full paragraph remains visible and readable without script.
fallback.reducedMotion: Remove all progressive word fills and masks; full text has correct contrast.
fallback.mobile: Use modest highlight; no horizontal moving marquee inside body copy.

systems.rejectWhen: Text is hidden until the user scrolls, reading order breaks, or every paragraph gets animated.

systems.title: Spatial Zoom Transit
systems.purpose: Explain a real nesting of scales, e.g. overview to a specific project detail.
systems.trigger: Local progress of a scene anchored to a sequence of verified visual contexts.
systems.canonicalState: Camera transform bounded by specific target anchors; not an infinite decorative zoom.
systems.visibleResult: View transitions from contextual overview to documented detail.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: CSS transformed images and anchor targets with static accessible alternatives.
implementation.advanced: Motion/GSAP transform timeline; optional WebGL only if real 3D is essential, with resource controls.

fallback.noJs: Overview image and detailed crop as separate images with headings and captions.
fallback.reducedMotion: Replace zoom with a simple cut and explicit navigation.
fallback.mobile: No large auto camera moves; stack detail and overview naturally.

systems.rejectWhen: Zoom adds no information or imposes rapid viewport-scale movement.

systems.title: Radial Chronology Navigator
systems.purpose: Represent a cyclical or recurring documented chronology with geometric navigation.
systems.trigger: Scroll progression or explicit selection of one dated milestone.
systems.canonicalState: One canonical active year/ID derived from chronology data, shared between ring and readable list.
systems.visibleResult: Ring markers encode actual ordered events; each event remains a semantic link and article.

implementation.baseline: Semantic HTML in reading order, content complete before enhancement.
implementation.native: Progressive enhanced SVG ring with native anchor-driven linear chronology underneath.
implementation.advanced: Motion/GSAP derive rotation from the single selected ID; never replace real chronological links.

fallback.noJs: Complete ordered dated timeline with real titles and active links.
fallback.reducedMotion: Hide ring and show linear chronology, with no fake frozen radial control.
fallback.mobile: Use a readable vertical index and direct anchors.

systems.rejectWhen: Events are simply linear and the radial structure creates worse comprehension.
